plugins.name: superskillret
plugins.description: Embedding-based skill retrieval. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool (ThakiCloud/SKILLRET) and injects them as context, using the ThakiCloud/SkillRet-Embedding-0.6B encoder behind a long-running local daemon. v0.2.1 fixes a UX bug where /plugin install / /plugin update without a fresh CC session left install.sh un-run forever; retrieve.py now lazy-forks it. v0.2.0 added /superskillret:add to register custom skills.
